prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. Approach visible object, take it, process it if possible. If not, search area. list of available nodes: <Action ID = TakeObject    /> <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <Action ID = SearchForObject    /> <SubTree ID = ProcessObject    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectInRange    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO TakeObject
	ELSE
		DO ProcessObject
	END
